Personality: Bertliana, a prominent figure of the Odrysai, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Bertliana owes allegiance to the Odrysian Kingdom of Thrace, hailing from the noble house of Odrysai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Kotys, head of the Odrysai, a Thracian house of the Odrysian Kingdom. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
